scope: Matched paper baselines required after, and only after, I8 satisfies the Phase-1 primary and held-out claim gates.

reasons: Existing standard LoRA uses rank 8 and dropout 0.05 rather than rank 32 and dropout 0.
Existing random-B rank-8 and original random-B runs use different rank, initialization, probe, and dropout protocols.
Historical runs are single training seed and were not generated inside the fixed Phase-1 provenance and paired-comparison chain.

standard_lora_r32.standard_initialization: PEFT default LoRA initialization with B initialized to zero; record the exact PEFT version and initializer.
standard_lora_r32.optimizer_and_rl_protocol: Identical to Phase 1, including learning rate, clipping, minibatch size, data seed, rollout seed, and checkpoint cadence.
standard_lora_r32.evaluation: The fixed six-benchmark snapshot, evaluation seed 42, 7248 records, and identical generation parameters.

base_model.role: No-RL reference on the same fixed evaluation snapshot.
base_model.evaluation: The fixed six-benchmark snapshot, evaluation seed 42, 7248 records, and identical generation parameters.

i8_vs_standard_lora_r32.per_seed: Matched problem-cluster bootstrap for seeds 42, 43, and 44.
i8_vs_standard_lora_r32.aggregate: Training-seed by problem hierarchical bootstrap using the existing Phase-1 thresholds.
i8_vs_standard_lora_r32.claim_rule: I8 cannot be claimed to improve standard LoRA unless this comparison passes the existing three-seed primary gate and the held-out claim gates.

i0_vs_standard_lora_r32.per_seed: Matched problem-cluster bootstrap for seeds 42, 43, and 44.
i0_vs_standard_lora_r32.purpose: Separate the effect of random orthogonal A initialization from the P2-plus-random mixture.

all_methods_vs_base.purpose: Report absolute RL improvement or degradation without using the untrained base as a paired training-seed claim.

secondary_if_compute_allows.standard_lora_r8_same_protocol: Run at least seed 42 with dropout 0 and the same snapshot to show the rank/parameter tradeoff; do not substitute the existing dropout-0.05 run.

reporting_requirements: Trainable and stored adapter parameter counts.
Peak GPU memory, training wall time, probe wall time, and evaluation wall time.
The 112-prompt P2 discovery/calibration/audit overhead reported separately from 50-step RL training.
No historical baseline may be relabeled as protocol matched.

estimated_additional_wall_time.standard_lora_r32_three_seeds_training_a: approximately 29-31 serial hours under current measurements
estimated_additional_wall_time.note: Do not spend this compute if I8 fails Phase 1 or either held-out claim gate.
